# Kenney Input Prompts

This project uses selected Generic, Xbox Series, PlayStation Series, and Nintendo Switch prompts from Kenney's Input Prompts 1.5A pack. The included source sheets and `LICENSE.txt` are from the user-provided `kenney_input-prompts_1.5` folder. Kenney releases the pack under CC0; attribution is not required, but is included here as a courtesy.

`controller_prompts.tga` is a generated 16-column controller-prompt atlas embedded in the ASI as a resource. To regenerate it after changing the source selections, run `tools/BuildControllerIconAtlas.ps1` from the project directory.

Upstream: <https://kenney.nl/assets/input-prompts>
License: [CC0 1.0](LICENSE.txt).
